summary: New box Infectum-wa: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (MAC NE Famine/62)

data.turoyo: N. Tadro kəmmútəlle, ʕaynənto! Hawoste šəkəl dgéloyo, xud a+šrule kowe, mdaqəd̥qíwaynanne, naxwəštə́r mu+syomayo layto, mdaqəd̥qíwaynanne ŭ bi+manduriye edi, ʕal i+šeno bi+manduriye hul dhowənwa aw+wariḏayḏe ḥuṭe.
data.translation: You call it tadro, ʕaynənto! This is also a kind of plant, it is like melon leaves, we would pound them, there is nothing worse than that work, we would pound them and with a stone roller then, against the rock with a stone roller, until its veins would become threads.

rationale: Fill Infectum-wa/1 with an explicit plant referent, stone roller and result in threads; one quote covers both repeated tokens.
